about_the_game:
RPG Sound Stories Vol.01 -The CLOCKWORK EMPIRE- is the first volume in a new BGM series designed with rich worldbuilding in mind.

This collection is inspired by a world where mechanical civilization and fantasy coexist and features a diverse range of tracks using orchestral arrangements, heavy metal elements, and synthesizers.

With a total of 16 tracks, this pack covers a wide range of scenes including towns, battles, dungeons, and key events.

A BGM collection themed around a fusion of mechanical civilization and fantasy

  • Main Theme: 1 track (Note: The main theme does not include a loop tag)

  • Battle: 5 tracks (Standard battles and boss battles)

  • Town: 4 tracks

  • Dungeon: 3 tracks

  • Event: 3 tracks

A total of 16 tracks, including alternate arrangements.

------

・This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.

・OK to be used in Commercial projects made in RPG Maker

・You may modify some of the assets (but not redistribute them) for your own game use only.
